title: Bind the live review to the physical object
source_heading_path: Placement-policy review scope, repair, and acceptance > Establish the live scope
use_when: Use when a routine placement review has historical and approved neighboring records.
retrieval_keywords: live review service catalog table partition binding
follow_up: Join the current review to the service and object catalogs before choosing a SQL target.
content: A routine placement review must bind the live review row to a service catalog entry and then to the table and partition catalogs. Historical closed rows and approved exceptions are nearby evidence, not the current repair target.

title: Partition overrides are more specific than table inheritance
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement policy inheritance > Scope precedence
use_when: Use when a table-level placement reset appears successful but a partition still has an explicit policy.
follow_up: Read information_schema.partitions for every partition after resetting the table.
content: TiDB placement inheritance is hierarchical: a database or global default is inherited when no object override exists, a table override wins over that default, and an explicit partition override wins over the table. Resetting a table to DEFAULT does not remove an explicit partition policy.

title: Interpret the complete placement policy definition
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement constraints and asynchronous progress > Policy fields
use_when: Use when policy names or a single replica field are insufficient to explain placement behavior.
retrieval_keywords: FOLLOWERS PRIMARY_REGION REGIONS SCHEDULE constraint dictionary
follow_up: Compare the complete information_schema.placement_policies row with available TiKV labels.
content: In TiDB 8.1, FOLLOWERS=n means n followers plus one leader. PRIMARY_REGION and REGIONS use TiKV region labels, SCHEDULE controls follower distribution, and dictionary constraints assign replica counts to constraint keys. Read the complete policy definition before interpreting one field.

title: Accepted policy does not prove realizable capacity
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement constraints and asynchronous progress > Capacity and progress
use_when: Use when an accepted policy remains pending on a small or label-constrained cluster.
retrieval_keywords: one TiKV FOLLOWERS pending capacity mismatch
Store labels Region peers placement policy
follow_up: Inspect Store list, labels, Region peers, and SHOW PLACEMENT before changing the object binding.
content: An accepted placement policy can remain unsatisfied when the requested replica count or label domains exceed the available TiKV Stores. Correlate Store labels, Region peers, policy fields, and SHOW PLACEMENT; do not treat SQL success as convergence.

title: Admission, scheduling, and convergence are different states
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement constraints and asynchronous progress > Capacity and progress
use_when: Use after a placement DDL returns success or after a first reset step.
follow_up: Re-read SHOW PLACEMENT FOR TABLE and the table/partition catalogs at the final boundary.
content: SHOW PLACEMENT reports asynchronous scheduling stages: a policy definition can have a null state while an attached object can be PENDING, INPROGRESS, or SCHEDULED. Re-read the target object after a change and distinguish admission from convergence.

title: Reset only the explicit target bindings
source_heading_path: Placement-policy review scope, repair, and acceptance > Smallest repair and final acceptance
use_when: Use when the reviewed object should return to inherited default placement.
retrieval_keywords: reset table partition placement policy DEFAULT smallest repair
do not alter shared policy definition
follow_up: Wait for target convergence, then close only the exact live review row.
content: For a default-inheritance review, reset only the mapped table and every explicitly overridden target partition to DEFAULT. Preserve shared policy definitions, approved or healthy neighbors, database/global placement, and PD scheduling.

title: Placement review acceptance is a closed loop
source_heading_path: Placement-policy review scope, repair, and acceptance > Smallest repair and final acceptance
use_when: Use for final acceptance after an object-level placement reset.
retrieval_keywords: final placement review closed business truth unchanged
follow_up: Check each invariant independently; report the exact review key and final object state.
content: Accept the review only after the target table and partitions inherit the intended default, target placement has converged, the exact review row is closed, protected definitions and neighbors are unchanged, and the trusted business truth is unchanged.
